statement: The recorded value claiming the cloud backup is on and all photos are uploaded is neither safe nor correct for this case, as this album is the sole copy of these irreplaceable family photos and no backup has occurred in two years.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer states "the recorded value claiming the cloud backup is on and all photos are uploaded is neither safe nor correct," directly contradicting the record.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
